root_seed_derivation.conversion: unsigned big-endian integer from the first eight digest bytes

evidence_boundary.source_dry_run_scope: After all candidate hashes and the design below were fixed, source-only dry runs checked typed applicability, 64/64 closure and callback accounting on the 12 open-development cases. They did not run the local solver, inspect Gold/target recovery, change a candidate mechanism, threshold, corpus member, seed, or gate.
evidence_boundary.purpose: One-replicate, nonpromotional mechanism screen for genuinely point-generating bounded discovery policies. A favorable result authorizes only a separately frozen replicate/holdout experiment.

case_selection.selection_rule: The same two predeclared parameter-extreme open-development instances per family used by Stage C. No Stage-D source or local outcome selected a case.

source_contract.normalized_domain: [-1,1]^d mapped stably to the public finite box
source_contract.insurance: 16 fresh independent-uniform points; exactly one at positions 1,5,...,61 in every arm
source_contract.raw_control: D0 uses candidate raw draws 1:48; ECP uses the identical maximum candidate stream and records every accepted raw index
source_contract.fallback: A disjoint fresh-IID namespace supplies the same normalized point for a given typed fallback slot in every arm; every fallback is prescored and locally serviced
source_contract.generator: Random.Xoshiro Float64, materialized once per namespace/case; normalized with muladd(2,u,-1)
source_contract.discard_rule: Every screened point is a proposal. ECP may reject only unevaluated raw draws. No proposal is deduplicated, clustered, target-merged, or hard-suppressed.

work_contract.prefix_rule: Start at 64 charged prescreens and include only the longest chronological prefix of whole local attempts whose observed callback total does not exceed the threshold; do not split or skip a crossing attempt.
work_contract.primary_authority: case-total observed callbacks at 600/1200/2400/4800 and terminal full-target recovery
work_contract.source_physical_ledger: The truth-blind source oracle has limit 384. Its observed count must equal the sum of per-arm declarations, budget_exhausted must be false, and the oracle is released before any local solve.
work_contract.simplicial_shared_base: The paired API physically shares base screens once; each hypothetical arm still pays 48 logical emitter screens. Raw physical and logical ledgers are both retained.

applicability.DIRECT_RECT_EMIT: finite normalization-resolved box and 1+2d<=48; its orbit control must have the same applicability
applicability.SIMPLICIAL_STAR_EMIT: finite normalization-resolved box, 2^d+1<=48 and fixed simplex/incidence memory caps; inapplicable cases remain in safety but are excluded from efficacy
applicability.ECP_LB_FULL: finite normalized raw matrix with at least one dimension; raw exhaustion is a typed IID fallback, not efficacy exclusion

decision_contract.headroom: An eligible case where the best matched control is not terminal full-target.
decision_contract.terminal_signal: Candidate has strictly more terminal distinct safe Gold targets than every matched control in at least two headroom cases, two families, and one family outside TANGENT/MULTIROOT.
decision_contract.equal_work_signal: At one or more fixed callback thresholds, candidate has strictly more distinct safe Gold targets than every matched control in at least two headroom cases, two families, and one family outside TANGENT/MULTIROOT.
decision_contract.noninferiority: Across eligible cases candidate pooled terminal distinct targets are no lower than each control; terminal loss cases do not outnumber terminal win cases; checkpoint loss cases do not outnumber checkpoint win cases.
decision_contract.favorable_t0: terminal_signal AND equal_work_signal AND noninferiority AND safety/accounting zero
decision_contract.next_step: A favorable T0 authorizes only a separately preregistered multi-replicate and representation/holdout experiment. It does not promote production code.
decision_contract.negative_step: Delete or retain experiment-local code only as a negative mechanism record; do not tune this one-replicate corpus or add case routing.

execution_contract.local_padding: The existing corpus adapter requires a 128-column maximum matrix. Columns 65:128 duplicate 1:64 only as structural padding; requested prefix (64,) must service exactly starts 1:64 and never the tail.
